title: Claim a quality-audit subject before fixing it, so parallel fix sessions do not fix one defect twice
problem: quality_audit.py queue shuffles subjects per session and sinks rows an open PR names, but a twin fix session that has not opened its PR yet is invisible to both, so two sessions fix the same defect and one PR is wasted.
evidence: 2026-11-25: two fix sessions took retail-pilot-intel #0 within minutes (PRs #18894 and #18903), per doc_friction in prompts/runs/2026-11-25-session_01AcxTtJmeNMaZCZx2XB4zcX.json and siblings
2026-11-25: a parallel fix session (PR #18905) rewrote the same marker.mjs the same way within an hour (same run records)
2026-11-16T16:41: two fix sessions took the top medium row the same minute (comment on quality_metrics.queue); the shuffle added then lowers the odds but does not stop it
change: quality_audit.py claim <subject> pushes a create-only branch claim/quality-fix/<subject-slug> (a child of origin/main with main's tree, so no path changes and no workflow runs), exit 4 if taken; queue reads live claims (6 h staleness) and shows those rows last, marked 'claimed N min ago'. Reuses roadmap_claim.py's push_claim (new base= argument).
metric: Run records per week whose doc_friction reports two fix sessions on one quality subject (grep 'quality_audit' + 'twin|parallel|same row')
